cases.prompt: This test is green on my machine and red in CI about one run in five. It waits 200 ms and then asserts the invoice was generated.
expectations: Names the fixed Thread.sleep as the defect rather than raising the wait
Replaces the sleep with a bounded await or latch that fails with a diagnostic on timeout
Explains the CI failure as scheduling variance on a loaded machine
Tags the test or the class slow if the wait is inherent, without making the assertion optional

cases.prompt: Our discount tests only fail on the last day of the month. The service calls Instant.now() directly.
expectations: Identifies the wall-clock read inside the subject as the root cause
Injects java.time.Clock into the constructor and pins Clock.fixed in the test
Adds boundary cases at the exact window edge rather than only the interior
Does not silence the failure with an assumption or a tolerance

cases.prompt: Should I add a @ParameterizedTest with 12 rows of a CsvSource for the pricing tiers, or write 12 separate test methods?
expectations: Recommends @EnumSource or a small @CsvSource because the tiers form an enumerable domain set
Keeps one expectation per parameterized method and moves the differing setup into a builder
Warns against parameterizing over mocks and suggests @Nested for differing preconditions
Sets a readable parameterized name and asserts the rounding edge explicitly

cases.prompt: Add @TestMethodOrder so the tests that create the customer run before the tests that read it.
expectations: Rejects test ordering as a mechanism and explains it hides shared state
Moves creation into a per-test builder or fixture so each test is self-sufficient
Confirms each test passes when run in isolation via surefire single-method selection
Escalates shared mutable state to the layering decision owned by the integration testing skill

cases.prompt: Review this JUnit 5 test: four separate assertEquals calls in a row, one try/catch for the exception case, and a getStatus() intermediate variable.
expectations: Replaces bare assertions with AssertJ assertThat and extracting for the projection
Converts the try/catch to assertThatThrownBy with isInstanceOf and hasMessageContaining
Groups the independent facts with SoftAssertions.assertSoftly or assertAll for a single report
Confirms the method name still reads as one present-tense assertion sentence

cases.prompt: Write an extension that resets a metrics registry before every test in our whole suite.
expectations: Flags that a global reset is better expressed as a @BeforeEach or a shared base class
Settles on the narrowest mechanism and justifies it against a custom extension
Keeps any extension free of assertions and free of production behavior checks
Verifies the change does not silently reorder or skip tests
